replies.body:
Hello TylerdotMichael!

These screenshots are not sufficient enough evidence to punish this player, as they could be jumping or appearing to be flying.
Thank you for your report, we will be keeping a close eye on this player :) Let us know if you acquire any more evidence.

~Midnightstorm(Liz)
